ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) with approximately 15-20% high-intensity (white) pixel distribution concentrated on the leading edges and distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast white mottling along the anterior margins of both lobes. Significant white pixel clustering at the left distal tip and trailing edge. Distinct white focal points located in the central-proximal region near the notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with an internal vertex angle of approximately 75 degrees; deep vertical penetration relative to the transverse axis of the fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-amplitude, irregular jaggedness on the left lobe trailing edge featuring multiple deep U-shaped excisions. Right lobe exhibits lower-amplitude, higher-frequency serrations with a more continuous edge profile.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edges exhibit a subtle concave trajectory from the median notch toward the tips; leading edges demonstrate a strong convex sweep.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense cluster of circular high-contrast pixel groups (barnacle colonization) localized at the extreme distal tip of the left lobe. Sparse isolated circular white spots across the right lobe surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Prominent near-vertical white linear disruption (rake mark) extending from the central notch area into the left lobe surface. Several shorter, faint horizontal linear scratches on the mid-left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Major irregular jagged excision/notch on the mid-trailing edge of the left lobe, indicating significant physical trauma. Multiple smaller irregular indentations across the trailing edge boundaries.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinctive vertical white 'slash' mark located immediately to the left of the median notch vertex.
